name: Simple Show Date
author: Come2theweb

sections.description:
Simple Show Date lets you display the current date, tomorrow, yesterday, or any custom date format on your WordPress site using easy shortcodes.

New in 1.2.0
* Menu moved under Settings (cleaner admin)
* New shortcodes: [ssdc2tw_year], [ssdc2tw_month], [ssdc2tw_day]
* Ideal for copyright footers: © [ssdc2tw_year] Your Company

Go to Settings → Simple Show Date, copy a shortcode, and paste it where you want the date to appear.

Features

  • Show today’s date
  • Show tomorrow / previous day / any relative day
  • Multiple built-in date formats
  • Custom date format shortcode
  • Dedicated shortcodes for Year, Month, Day
  • Perfect for automatic copyright year
  • Fully compatible with all devices
  • Lightweight – no conflicts with other plugins
  • Completely free – no ads or upsells

Shortcodes

Quick year / month / day (new)
* [ssdc2tw_year] – Current year (e.g. 2026)
* [ssdc2tw_month] – Current month name (e.g. October)
* [ssdc2tw_day] – Current day number (e.g. 27)
* [ssdc2tw_custom_date format="Y"] – Same as year shortcode

Default styles
* [ssdc2tw_date] – Default format
* [ssdc2tw_date style="2"] – d/m/Y
* [ssdc2tw_date style="3"] – Full day name
* [ssdc2tw_date style="4"] – 27 Oct 2026
* [ssdc2tw_date style="5"] – October 27, 2026
* [ssdc2tw_date day="1"] – Tomorrow
* [ssdc2tw_date day="-1"] – Yesterday

Custom format
* [ssdc2tw_custom_date format="d/m/Y"]
* [ssdc2tw_custom_date day="2" format="l, F j, Y"]
* [ssdc2tw_custom_date format="Y"] – Year only
* [ssdc2tw_custom_date format="F"] – Month name only
sections.installation:
1. Upload the simple-show-date folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Simple Show Date.
  4. Copy the shortcode you need and paste it on any page, post, widget, or theme footer.
sections.faq:
How do I show today’s date?

Use the shortcode [ssdc2tw_date].

How do I show only the current year (for copyright)?

Use [ssdc2tw_year] or [ssdc2tw_custom_date format="Y"].
Example: © [ssdc2tw_year] Your Company Name

How do I show tomorrow or yesterday?

Use the day attribute: [ssdc2tw_date day="1"] for tomorrow, [ssdc2tw_date day="-1"] for yesterday.

Can I use a custom date format?

Yes. Use [ssdc2tw_custom_date format="YOUR_FORMAT"].

Where can I get support?

Contact us at support@come2theweb.com or info@come2theweb.com.
